verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Sun and moon and stars
All declaring who You are
Bowing to His majesty
The One who cares for me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Come and see what God has done
His awesome deeds toward all He loves
Let the sound of praise be heard
Shout for joy to God, all the earth

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
All creation sings Your praise
Every creature bow to say
To the One who reigns on high
All glory, power, and might

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Every mountain sing high
Every valley sing low
Everything in between
Sing the harmony
